# [EPIC] Cloud Deployment & Observability (Terraform, Kubernetes, Prometheus, ELK)

## Epic
Get Filmpire running in the cloud (Terraform + Kubernetes) with Prometheus/Grafana metrics and ELK logging, at $0 real cost: a local observability stack, Kustomize-based Kubernetes manifests, Terraform for Azure AKS and AWS (k3s on EC2), and gated CI/CD to publish images and deploy on demand.

## Business Value
Proves the platform runs on real cloud infrastructure with production-grade observability, not just local docker-compose — the kind of thing worth defending in a technical interview.

## Product Goal alignment
Directly serves the [Product Goal](../../docs/process/PRODUCT_GOAL.md): "disciplined enough to defend in a technical interview — built at $0 real cost."

## Notes
Hard $0 (free-credits-covered) cloud budget throughout — local-first,
ephemeral clusters, no paid extras.

All 4 child Stories are closed and verified. #90 (in-app admin view + Kibana
dashboard suite) closed 2026-08-04 once its last Technical Task (#112,
Kibana homepage linking the Lens dashboard suite) shipped and was verified
against a live local Kibana instance. This Epic is genuinely done.
